title: User guide
subtitle: A complete reference for working with Trade CRM. Pick a section on the left or use search.
emptyDescription: Select a section from the contents.

basics.title: Getting started
basics.summary: Sign-in, desktop and mobile navigation, quick search, swipe actions, picker sheets, filters, and roles.

dashboard.title: Dashboard and reports
dashboard.summary: The home screen for owners and administrators: Overview, Inventory, Products, and Sellers.

transactions.title: Sales and transactions
transactions.summary: Recording cash/card sales and debts, quick due dates, payments, and partial or full refunds.

debtors.title: Debtors and payments
debtors.summary: Debtor profiles, one-tap debt payment and credit issuance, and repayment risk scores.

products.title: Products and categories
products.summary: The catalog, quick stock addition ("Restock"), stock health badges, units, and categories.

markets.title: Markets
markets.summary: "Markets" and "My market": staff, products, debtors, transactions, and role permissions.

people.title: Sellers and users
people.summary: Accounts and roles, seller markup balance, payouts, and payout history.

offline.title: Offline mode and syncing
offline.summary: Working without internet, the send queue, per-section refresh, and device storage.

profile.title: Profile and settings
profile.summary: Personal details, avatar, password change, sync shortcut, theme, language, and signing out.
